use pipestream_search::postings::{AnalyzedDoc, Bm25Store};
#[test]
fn generate() {
    let mut store = Bm25Store::with_fields(&["body"]).with_integers(&["value"]);
    for row in 0..4 {
        store.add_document(row, "word".into(), AnalyzedDoc::body(vec![("word".into(), 1, vec![(0, 4)])], 1));
    }
    for (row, value) in [(0, -7), (2, 0), (3, i64::MAX)] {
        store.set_integer(0, row, value);
    }
    store.save(std::path::Path::new("tests/fixtures/integer-presence/legacy-kind4.bm25")).unwrap();
}
